meta.write: tube budget as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. You asked the tube. Full D budgets the packet. Angular loses. Neither reading is a bound. Do not cancel to Φ.

lemmas.name: B24_tube_readable
lemmas.statement: B4c packet budget and B5b angular ratio are readable together
lemmas.why: R_D sits below 1 and falls with j*. R_ang sits above 1 and climbs. Full D_tube budgets the packet. Angular does not. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B24a_angular_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: the extra 1/r² piece closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: R_ang > 1 and climbs. A failed Poincaré is not continuation. B5b already missed domination.

lemmas.name: B24b_b4c_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: the B4c packet tube budget is a closed a priori bound for classical X
lemmas.why: B4c budgets |I_tube| on a packet class. B4b killed all-data Hardy. B23c: one triad is not Leray. A budget is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B24c_rd_not_bounded
lemmas.statement: R_D ≪ 1 on packets implies X ∈ L∞
lemmas.why: Dissipation beats the tube source on this class. That is a ratio, not Beale. DNS-never-blew-up is refused. So is tube-ratio-never-blew-up.

lemmas.name: B24d_not_revive_hardy_or_phi
lemmas.statement: therefore revive all-data Hardy, or cancel to Φ = Γ/r²
lemmas.why: B4b and B5e already failed those slogans. Keep Γ. Keep 1/r^4. B4c still budgets the packet. Do not cancel to Φ.

lemmas.name: B24e_geometry_leftover
lemmas.why: Scored as B14d / B25. Lipschitz plus a conditional is not continuation. Stretching budget leftover is B15e.

lemmas.name: B24f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring the tube budget as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The ratio is a knob on the estimate. No Q1. No ε. No Φ cancel.

next_da_move: Packet geometry is not an a priori (B14d). Stretching budget leftover is B15e. Finer (n>32) stays a box knob (B22e). Do not spawn n=64. B4c stands. Do not cancel to Φ.
